currentHttpTests.scope: Actual local HTTP/process tests on Windows for current source and freshly extracted complete package. No browser, external network, original executable or physical macOS test.

limits: A complete gameplay or visual1:1 recreation of Empire Earth II is not achieved.
Native BASE combat tables are used consistently with current unit stats; installed UP5 tables are a separate source layer.
Full native AI, civilization sets, roster, special abilities, veteran/elite systems, weather, lighting and terrain generation remain incomplete.
Urban membership follows reconstructed completed-TC lifecycles and persisted radius maxima; complete native CityManager ownership/history registration is not reproduced.
No browser/HUD interaction, Internet/WebRTC connectivity or physical macOS execution was tested for this build.
All imported media are in the local portable ZIP. Original media are excluded from the proposed GitHub source payload.
